content_blocks.heading: How should you evaluate a Dot & Key Skincare offer before buying?
content_blocks.body: Check the exact Dot & Key Skincare product/offer on the official site, confirm the final checkout price and eligibility, and review shipping, return/refund, and policy terms before paying. Do not count a promo code or cashback claim unless it is clearly applied to your cart.

items.title: Ingredient/claim check
items.body: Verify the exact product's ingredient list, usage directions, and any certification/claim on the label or official page. Don't assume claims apply across all SKUs.

items.title: Variant/shade check
items.body: Confirm shade, size, skin/hair type fit, and return eligibility before ordering. Beauty purchases are often hard to return once opened.

items.title: Offer check
items.body: Test coupons, bundles, or gifts-with-purchase in checkout. Only count savings/benefits that appear in the final cart.
